question: Under the completed no-fast-kernel baseline settings and original fixed seeds, is this small local receptor MSA sufficient to recover parent complex engineering readiness?
not_tested: general MSA utility or all causes of prior prediction failure

input_representation.model_representation: Unchanged 1-164 core + standard parent 23mer; not exact assay chemistry.
omissions: N-terminal receptor c-myc/TEV junction of unrecovered complete sequence
input_representation.uncertainty: Assay clone Q133 identity not independently recovered; do not silently change to R133.

baseline.comparison: Existing same-seed no-fast-kernel parent jobs; reuse confidence/geometry, never rerun or rescore baseline.

intervention: Local receptor MSA plus necessary non-single MSA ingestion/effective-depth changes; all other prediction and relaxation settings held fixed relative to kernel branch.

msa_policy.input: Local source-audited A3M containing 22 receptor homologs + receptor query; peptide query only.
msa_policy.enum_interpretation: This installed CLI has no 'custom' enum; non-single mode preserves provided A3M. Exact .a3m file input bypasses get_msa_and_templates; the enum does NOT authorize MMseqs/remote search.
msa_policy.effective_difference: Old single_sequence clamped these to 1/1 and discarded homolog rows. New non-single mode removes this clamp. This necessary MSA feature-depth change is part of the intervention, not a claim that only the file path changes.
msa_policy.query_pairing: Only the concatenated query is paired; no inferred receptor-peptide homolog pairing.

code_and_asset_checks.model_parameter_verification: Expected hash reused from prior actual run; bulk parameter file must be hashed again at future launch. No weight loading/hash claimed in this input audit.

budget.accounting: Sum each child wall time once; wall time is not GPU-utilization integral. Watchdog enforces aggregate active+completed time and output cap.

quality_gate_unchanged.interface_pae_definition: Maximum PAE over all directed receptor-to-peptide and peptide-to-receptor residue pairs; pass only if <=10 A.
quality_gate_unchanged.peptide_plddt_definition: Mean C-alpha pLDDT over all peptide-chain residues; pass only if >=70.
quality_gate_unchanged.iptm_definition: AFM summary ipTM; pass only if >=0.70.
quality_gate_unchanged.clash_definition: Minimum heavy-atom interchain distance must be >=1.5 A; otherwise fail the structural gate.

other_required_gates: Exact A164/B23 sequences and contiguous numbering
At least one unique heavy-atom-defined residue contact <=6 A
After identical restrained Amber relaxation, minimum interchain heavy-atom distance >=1.5 A

additional_diagnostic_gate.note: Added engineering readiness check; never retroactively changes original pilot pass count.

analysis_freeze.chain_mapping: A=unchanged 164-aa receptor; B=unchanged 23-aa peptide; exact sequences and contiguous 1-based numbering in raw and relaxed PDB.
analysis_freeze.confidence: Raw score JSON ipTM; raw CA pLDDT means for A/B; maximum over ALL A->B and B->A PAE entries, not contact-restricted or median.
analysis_freeze.geometry: After identical CPU restrained relaxation, minimum cross-chain heavy-atom distance >=1.5 A and >=1 unique cross-chain residue pair with any heavy atoms <=6 A. Also retain raw geometry and heavy-atom pair count separately.
analysis_freeze.consistency: Cross-check JSON pLDDT against raw CA B factors and score PAE against exported PAE; report exact tolerances from serialization, fail on inconsistent identity/array shapes/nonfinite values.
analysis_freeze.reference_use: Reuse metric definitions or isolated pure helpers in a NEW output-directed evaluator. Existing runner and summarizer contain old hardcoded output paths and must not be directly launched for this protocol.
analysis_freeze.paired_changes: For each fixed seed report new-minus-existing-baseline confidence and geometry; never pool two seeds into a pass.

preflight_before_future_start: Require a future explicit instruction to start this prepared protocol. Current authorization is preparation only.
Verify applicable AGENTS, protocol/input SHA256, old source/pilot/kernel integrity and inherited unchanged frozen criteria.
Verify exact installed code/version/executable/model hashes, GPU availability and disk capacity; do not reinstall, download, kill unrelated jobs or change precision/options on OOM.
Require a clean new output root. Freeze any necessary unique path change before launch and preserve old outputs.
Repeat installed A3M ingestion checks and ensure a3m_lines is provided and templates disabled. Deny any fallback to remote MSA/template services or weight downloads.
Use a new budget wrapper/evaluator bound to this protocol and new output root. Do not directly reuse old scripts with hardcoded kernel paths. Count each child interval once.

Verify saved A3M still contains 22 receptor homologs, query-only peptide, unchanged chain sequences, and no single_sequence clamp. Record actual config and MSA feature depth; lost homologs are an execution failure.

frozen_decision.2_of_2_all_original_and_auxiliary_gates_: GO_TO_SEPARATE_REVIEW_ONLY; evidence of parent readiness under this MSA+settings bundle, not affinity or H validation. No mutant run automatically follows.
frozen_decision.0_of_2_pass: HOLD_THIS_MSA_DIAGNOSTIC; no gate loosening or expansion; does not prove that all other MSAs, constructs or runtime factors are ineffective.
frozen_decision.input_runtime_budget_or_execution_failur: Stop, preserve failed jobs/logs and denominator; no automatic fallback, new seed, precision, template or additional compute.
frozen_decision.better_confidence_but_gate_failure: Descriptive improvement only, classified as gate failure.

formal_direction_criteria: Unchanged v2. No formal Kd labels or direction metrics are released. Existing failures/ties and GraphPep/FoldX 0.05 bands remain preserved.
